decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; Existing 9722. Received 06/03/2018. 9772m.c rev3. Received 12/03/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope. The frames of the roof lights shall be in colour matching the existing roof tiles and shall be retained as such thereafter.
Condition : 6 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Conversion of the loft into a habitable room with  two front roof windows to the house.
